title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #3

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which habit helps to prevent many diseases? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing dirty cups
   B. Playing in dirty water
   C. Not bathing
   D. Washing hands with soap

2. Which of these is a safe touch? (1 mark)
   A. A touch you have been told to keep secret
   B. A touch that scares you
   C. A hug from a parent
   D. Touching your private parts by a stranger

3. Who preached to the crowd at Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. Judas
   B. Stephen
   C. Peter
   D. Thomas

4. What is a consequence? (1 mark)
   A. A holiday
   B. A result of what we choose
   C. A school subject
   D. A type of song

5. What does "keep in step with the Spirit" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Follow the Spirit's guidance each day
   B. Walk in a line
   C. Run fast
   D. Dance

6. What should you do if an adult tells you to do something that hurts you? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   B. Copy it
   C. Hide it
   D. Obey

7. What did Stephen pray for those stoning him? (1 mark)
   A. Take me away
   B. Lord, do not hold this sin against them
   C. Punish them
   D. Send fire

8. Which group of books in the Old Testament is known as the Law? (1 mark)
   A. Joshua to Esther
   B. Genesis to Deuteronomy
   C. Job to Song of Songs
   D. Isaiah to Malachi

9. Which commandment says "Honour your father and your mother"? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. Exodus 20:12
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. Exodus 20:16

10. Which verse compares a person without self-control to a broken city wall? (1 mark)
   A. Proverbs 1:7
   B. Proverbs 25:28
   C. John 3:16
   D. Acts 2:38

11. What does "lead us not into temptation" ask? (1 mark)
   A. That God gives gifts
   B. That God keeps us from doing wrong
   C. That God punishes us
   D. That God hides us

12. What did Joseph do when he was tempted? (1 mark)
   A. Stayed to argue
   B. Refused and ran away
   C. Agreed
   D. Told everyone

13. Who would come upon Mary so that she could conceive? (1 mark)
   A. Elizabeth
   B. The Holy Spirit
   C. Joseph
   D. An angel

14. What did Jesus say to the disciples about the children? (1 mark)
   A. Send them away
   B. They are too small
   C. Let them come to me
   D. Wait for tomorrow

15. What does patience mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being angry
   B. Waiting calmly without losing your temper
   C. Rushing
   D. Refusing to wait

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give four things that help our faith to grow. (4 marks)

17. List two attributes of God. (2 marks)

18. State two ways of respecting the church building. (2 marks)

19. State two reasons why we should tell the truth. (2 marks)

20. Give two ways of showing love at home. (2 marks)

21. Describe what Jesus did to raise the widow's son. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Washing hands with soap
   Clean hands prevent the spread of germs.

2. C — A hug from a parent
   A hug from a parent is safe and loving.

3. C — Peter
   Peter spoke boldly.

4. B — A result of what we choose
   A consequence is the result of a choice.

5. A — Follow the Spirit's guidance each day
   Galatians 5:25.

6. A — Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   Obedience is only for good instructions.

7. B — Lord, do not hold this sin against them
   Acts 7:60.

8. B — Genesis to Deuteronomy
   The first five books are called the Law.

9. B — Exodus 20:12
   Exodus 20:12 says to honour parents.

10. B — Proverbs 25:28
   Proverbs 25:28.

11. B — That God keeps us from doing wrong
   We ask protection from temptation.

12. B — Refused and ran away
   He left his cloak and ran out of the house.

13. B — The Holy Spirit
   Luke 1:35 says the Holy Spirit would come on her.

14. C — Let them come to me
   Matthew 19:14 records His welcome.

15. B — Waiting calmly without losing your temper
   Patience is calm waiting.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Prayer, Bible reading, worship with others, obedience, good friends.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid thing up to 4.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Sole Creator, loving Father, holy. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each attribute.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Enter quietly, do not litter, keep phones silent, take care of Bibles.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: God commands it; people trust us; we feel peaceful; friendships stay strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Obey parents, help with chores, be kind to siblings, care for younger children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: He felt compassion, told the woman not to cry, touched the bier and told the young man to get up.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for compassion, 1 for touching the bier, 1 for the command.
